name: Cursor
short: Agent-first IDE from Anysphere with one shared Cursor/Grok usage pool; third-party models are available at API list price, billed separately.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Grok-only models: Chat, Voice, Imagine, Build and Grok API access in a shared usage pool.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 4x Plus usage; latest Grok, cloud agents, code hosting and reviews; third-party models at API list price (billed by usage).

plans.name: Super
plans.notes: 15x Plus usage; priority model access at peak times.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: 50x Plus usage; earliest access to all products and models.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Pooled usage (4-50x Plus), centralized billing, SSO and admin controls; Enterprise is custom.
